card.name: Numbers and years in social media stats
card.fires_on: The space or digit just before or inside a number, such as a year (2010, 2005, 2009) or a user count, in web text about social media, technology or statistics.

modes.label: Space before a figure
modes.description: The blank before a large count or percentage, often in facts about users or energy.

modes.label: Inside a year or version number
modes.description: A digit or dot partway through a year or version number from the 2000s.

card.writes: It promotes social media words like hashtag, Twitter and Instagram, and suppresses fax.
card.plain: It fires inside numbers and dates in web text about social media and tech, and nudges the model toward social-media words.
